_meta.description: Configuration payload for the Outlook 'email-received' connector trigger in a UiPath Flow. This is the value passed verbatim as --detail to 'uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --detail <...>'. Placeholder tokens enclosed in <ANGLE_BRACKETS> must be replaced before running node configure against a live tenant.

placeholders.<OUTLOOK_CONNECTION_ID>: UUID of the Integration Service connection for Microsoft Mail. Resolve with: uip is connections list "microsoft-mail" --all-folders --output json  — pick the enabled connection (prefer IsDefault:Yes) and copy its Id field.
placeholders.<ORCHESTRATOR_FOLDER_KEY>: Numeric key of the Orchestrator folder that owns the connection. Shown as FolderKey in the connections list response, or retrieve with: uip folders list --output json.
placeholders.<INBOX_FOLDER_ID>: The IS object ID of the mailbox folder to monitor (e.g. Inbox). Resolve with: uip is resources run list "microsoft-mail" "MailFolder" --connection-id <OUTLOOK_CONNECTION_ID> --output json — match displayName 'Inbox' and copy the id field. This value is connection-scoped; do NOT reuse an ID from a different connection.

howToApply: 1. uip solution init OutlookFlowSolution && cd OutlookFlowSolution
3. uip maestro flow node remove OutlookFlow/OutlookFlow.flow start --output json

4. uip maestro flow node add OutlookFlow/OutlookFlow.flow uipath.connector.trigger.microsoft-mail.email-received --label "Email received" --position 200,144 --output json   # note the generated nodeId
5. Replace placeholders in this file, then run:

uip maestro flow node configure OutlookFlow/OutlookFlow.flow <nodeId> --detail "$(cat trigger_detail.json | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d["detail"]))' )" --output json
